name: humanizer
description: Humanize prose and lyrics, preserve the writer's voice, score rap technique, optimize verses and hooks, and generate BPM-aware flow patterns.

interface.shortDescription: Humanize writing and optimize lyrics without flattening the writer's voice.
interface.longDescription: Humanizer rewrites AI-sounding prose and lyrics while preserving meaning, concrete details, and voice. For rap, it can score artifact risk, multisyllabic rhyme, pocket, cadence, and rhyme density; protect strong bars; optimize full verses and verse-to-hook transitions; use supplied BPM and meter for beat-grid-aware analysis; and suggest context-aware flow patterns without pretending text alone reveals exact performed microtiming.
defaultPrompt: Humanize this text while preserving my voice and every supported fact.
Score these lyrics for AI-writing artifacts, then rewrite only the weak lines.
Analyze this rap verse for multis, pocket, cadence, and rhyme density, then improve the weak bars without touching the strong ones.
At 142 BPM in 4/4, optimize this verse and hook together and suggest a flow pattern for each bar.
